violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. PIC AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION ONLY HAD A CERTIFIED FOOD HANDLER CERTIFICATION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC WITH A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATION ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THERE IS A CFM ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

violations.title: Food from Approved Source
violations.observation: The following food items are not from an approved food preparation/processing facility: FACILITY IS SELLING EMPANADAS FROM ANOTHER RESTAURANT THAT IS NOT A MANUFACTURER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with the Law. PIC AGREED TO DISCONTINUE SELLING THESE FOOD ITEMS. PLEASE CONTACT THE EHS IF YOU HAVE ANY FURTHER QUESTIONS.
